answer: PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) is the automotive-industry workflow in which a supplier proves to its customer that its production line can consistently manufacture a given part at the quoted rate, using documented evidence rather than a one-off sample. It typically involves submitting a Part Submission Warrant plus dimensional results, material and performance test data, and process-capability studies, after which the customer approves the part, requests corrective action, or asks for more evidence.
